fleetMemoryScratch.LESSON: Cloud Run's status.traffic mixes tag-only (0%) entries with the serving entry; the serving revision is the one with percent==100. Reading the array by position misidentifies it (this produced the planner's 00080-yax flag).

In legacy-design-tools, a push to main does not deploy cortex-api — cloud-run-deploy.yml's push trigger is build-and-push only; a deploy is workflow_dispatch deploy-canary (image_tag=<sha>) then shift-traffic. 'Merge = deploy' is false for this repo.

gcloud run deploy --source leaves the exact source zip in gs://run-sources-<project>-<region>/...; extracting it and diffing a data file against origin/main is a field-name-grade way to prove what a serving revision actually contains without reading a working tree.
